## asusctl

```text
Usage: asusctl <command> [<args>]

asusctl command-line options

Options:
  --help, help      display usage information

Commands:
  aura              aura device commands
  leds              keyboard brightness control
  profile           profile management
  fan-curve         fan curve commands
  anime             anime commands
  slash             slash ledbar commands
  scsi              scsi LED commands
  armoury           armoury / firmware attributes
  backlight         backlight options
  battery           battery options
  info              show program version and system info
  xgmled            XG Mobile LED control
```

## asusctl anime

```text
Usage: asusctl anime [--override-type <override-type>] [--enable-display <enable-display>] [--enable-powersave-anim <enable-powersave-anim>] [--brightness <brightness>] [--clear] [--off-when-unplugged <off-when-unplugged>] [--off-when-suspended <off-when-suspended>] [--off-when-lid-closed <off-when-lid-closed>] [--off-with-his-head <off-with-his-head>] [<command>] [<args>]

anime commands

Options:
  --override-type   override the display type
  --enable-display  enable/disable the display
  --enable-powersave-anim
                    enable/disable the builtin run/powersave animation
  --brightness      set global base brightness value <off, low, med, high>
  --clear           clear the display
  --off-when-unplugged
                    turn the anime off when external power is unplugged
  --off-when-suspended
                    turn the anime off when the laptop suspends
  --off-when-lid-closed
                    turn the anime off when the lid is closed
  --off-with-his-head
                    off with his head!!!
  --help, help      display usage information

Commands:
  image             display a PNG image
  pixel-image       display a diagonal/pixel-perfect PNG
  gif               display an animated GIF
  pixel-gif         display an animated diagonal/pixel-perfect GIF
  set-builtins      change which builtin animations are shown
```

## asusctl anime gif

```text
Usage: asusctl anime gif --path <path> [--scale <scale>] [--x-pos <x-pos>] [--y-pos <y-pos>] [--angle <angle>] [--bright <bright>] [--loops <loops>]

display an animated GIF

Options:
  --path            full path to the gif to display
  --scale           scale 1.0 == normal
  --x-pos           x position (float)
  --y-pos           y position (float)
  --angle           the angle in radians
  --bright          brightness 0.0-1.0
  --loops           how many loops to play - 0 is infinite
  --help, help      display usage information
```

## asusctl anime set-builtins

```text
Usage: asusctl anime set-builtins --boot <boot> --awake <awake> --sleep <sleep> --shutdown <shutdown> [--set <set>]

change which builtin animations are shown

Options:
  --boot            default is used if unspecified, <default:GlitchConstruction,
                    StaticEmergence>
  --awake           default is used if unspecified, <default:BinaryBannerScroll,
                    RogLogoGlitch>
  --sleep           default is used if unspecified, <default:BannerSwipe,
                    Starfield>
  --shutdown        default is used if unspecified, <default:GlitchOut, SeeYa>
  --set             set/apply the animations <true/false>
  --help, help      display usage information
```

## asusctl aura effect

```text

  flash             single-colour flash effect
```

## asusctl aura power-tuf

```text
Usage: asusctl aura power-tuf [--awake <awake>] [--keyboard] [--lightbar] [--boot <boot>] [--sleep <sleep>] [--shutdown <shutdown>]

aura power (old ROGs and TUF laptops)

Options:
  --awake           control if LEDs enabled while awake <true/false>
  --keyboard        use with awake option; if excluded defaults to false
  --lightbar        use with awake option; if excluded defaults to false
  --boot            control boot animations <true/false>
  --sleep           control suspend animations <true/false>
  --shutdown        control if LEDs enabled while shutting down <true/false>
  --help, help      display usage information
```

## asusctl fan-curve

```text
Usage: asusctl fan-curve [--get-enabled] [--default] [--mod-profile <mod-profile>] [--enable-fan-curves <enable-fan-curves>] [--enable-fan-curve <enable-fan-curve>] [--fan <fan>] [--data <data>]

fan curve commands

Options:
  --get-enabled     get enabled fan profiles
  --default         set the active profile's fan curve to default
  --mod-profile     profile to modify fan-curve for. shows data if no options
                    provided
  --enable-fan-curves
                    enable or disable <true/false> fan all curves for a profile;
                    --mod_profile required
  --enable-fan-curve
                    enable or disable <true/false> a single fan curve for a
                    profile; --mod_profile and --fan required
  --fan             select fan <cpu/gpu/mid> to modify; --mod_profile required
  --data            data format = 30c:1%,49c:2%,...; --mod-profile required. If
                    '%' is omitted the fan range is 0-255
  --help, help      display usage information
```

## asusctl scsi

```text
Usage: asusctl scsi [--enable <enable>] [--mode <mode>] [--speed <speed>] [--direction <direction>] [--colours <colours...>] [--list]

scsi LED commands

Options:
  --enable          enable the SCSI drive LEDs
  --mode            set LED mode (use 'list' for all options)
  --speed           set LED mode speed <slowest, slow, med, fast, fastest>
  --direction       set LED mode direction <forward, reverse>
  --colours         set LED colours <hex>, specify up to 4 with repeated arg
  --list            list available animations
  --help, help      display usage information
```

## asusctl slash set

```text
Usage: asusctl slash set [--enable] [--disable] [-l <brightness>] [--interval <interval>] [--mode <mode>] [-B <show-on-boot>] [-S <show-on-shutdown>] [-s <show-on-sleep>] [-b <show-on-battery>] [-w <show-battery-warning>]

set slash ledbar options

Options:
  --enable          enable the Slash Ledbar
  --disable         disable the Slash Ledbar
  -l, --brightness  set brightness value <0-255>
  --interval        set interval value <0-5>
  --mode            set SlashMode (use 'list' for options)
  -B, --show-on-boot
                    show the animation on boot
  -S, --show-on-shutdown
                    show the animation on shutdown
  -s, --show-on-sleep
                    show the animation on sleep
  -b, --show-on-battery
                    show the animation on battery
  -w, --show-battery-warning
                    show the low-battery warning animation
  --help, help      display usage information
```
